# NGSS Life Science

> > NGSS-aligned life science curriculum providing free lesson plans, worksheets, and labs for high school and middle school biology teachers.

NGSS Life Science offers comprehensive biology curriculum resources aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS), including standards HS-LS1 (molecular biology), HS-LS2 (ecosystems), HS-LS3 (heredity), and HS-LS4 (evolution). The site provides editable worksheets, hands-on labs, and digital learning resources for science educators.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- High school biology curriculum
- Middle school science resources
- HS-LS1 standards (molecular & cellular biology)
- HS-LS3 standards (heredity & genetics)
- HS-LS4 standards (biological evolution)
- Free lesson plans & worksheets
- Biomolecules & biochemistry
- DNA replication & protein synthesis
- Genetics & Punnett squares
- Ecosystem interactions (LS2)
- NGSS-aligned labs
- Editable teacher resources
- Science and Engineering Practices
- Blended & digital learning

## Getting Started

- [Science and Engineering Practices & NGSS Curriculum](https://www.ngsslifescience.com): Homepage for NGSS-aligned science curriculum for high school & middle school
- [Biology Lesson Plans: Free Worksheets, Projects & Labs](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/biology-lesson-plans): Free NGSS biology curriculum with labs, worksheets & projects for teachers
- [Blended Learning Links: NGSS Science Resources](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/lesson-plans-links): NGSS resources & blended learning links using Google Apps for educators

## Molecular & Cellular Biology (HS-LS1)

- [Biochemistry Labs: Free Metabolism Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/biochemistry-labs): Biochemistry labs & metabolism worksheets aligned with HS-LS1-6, MS-LS1-7
- [Carbohydrate Worksheets, Free Carbohydrate Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/carbohydrate-worksheets): Carbohydrate & biomolecule worksheets aligned with HS-LS1-6, MS-LS1-7
- [Enzyme Worksheets: Free Protein Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/enzymes-worksheets): Enzyme & protein worksheets with catalase lab aligned to HS-LS1-3, HS-LS1-6
- [DNA Worksheets: Free DNA Replication & RNA Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/dna-replication-worksheets): DNA replication & RNA worksheets aligned with HS-LS1-4, HS-LS3-1 standards
- [Protein Synthesis Worksheets: Transcription & Translation](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/protein-synthesis-worksheets): Transcription & translation worksheets aligned with HS-LS1-1, HS-LS1-4

## Genetics & Heredity (HS-LS3)

- [Punnett Square Worksheets: Free Genetics Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/punnett-square-worksheets): Punnett square & Mendelian genetics worksheets aligned with HS-LS3-3

## Ecosystems & Evolution (LS2 & LS4)

- [NGSS Lesson Plans LS2: Ecosystem Interactions & Energy](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/ngss-lesson-plans-ecosystems): Ecosystem interactions & energy transfer lessons aligned with NGSS LS2
- [NGSS Lesson Plans LS4: Biological Evolution & Diversity](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/ngss-lesson-plans-biological-evolution): Evolution & diversity lesson plans aligned with NGSS LS4 standards

## Teaching Strategies & Classroom Management

- [Teaching Gifted Students So They Are Challenged Academically](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/classroom-management-challenge-academically): Strategies for challenging gifted students & improving classroom engagement
- [How to Create a Safe Classroom Environment using Respect](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/classroom-management-safe-environment): Classroom management strategies for creating safe learning environments
